application_credentials.description:
To use the Sharesight integration, create an API application at the [Sharesight Developer Portal]({developer_portal_url}). Set the **Redirect URI** in your Sharesight app to your [Home Assistant redirect URL]({redirect_url}), then enter the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** below.

Standard and developer accounts have separate application registries — a standard Client ID is not valid on the developer sandbox. If you use both, add a credential for each and name them so you can tell them apart.

pick_account_type.title: Select Sharesight account type
pick_account_type.description: Choose the type of Sharesight account you are connecting. Standard is correct for almost everyone. Developer accounts use Sharesight's sandbox and require separate credentials issued by Sharesight.

data_description.account_type: Standard suits almost everyone. Choose Developer only if Sharesight has issued you separate sandbox credentials.

pick_implementation.title: Select Sharesight credentials
pick_implementation.description: Pick the application credential matching the account type you selected. A standard credential will not work on the developer sandbox, and vice versa.

portfolio.title: Select Portfolio
portfolio.description: Select the Sharesight portfolio you want to monitor.

data_description.portfolio_id: The Sharesight portfolio Home Assistant will create a device and sensors for.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Sharesight
reauth_confirm.description: Your Sharesight credentials have expired or been revoked. Click submit to re-authenticate.

init.title: Sharesight options
init.description: Configure how frequently Home Assistant polls the Sharesight API for this portfolio. Must be between 60 and 3600 seconds.

data.enable_lts_backfill: Backfill portfolio value history into long-term statistics
data.auto_remove_stale_devices: Automatically delete devices for sold holdings

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant polls the Sharesight API for this portfolio. Must be between 60 and 3600 seconds.
data_description.enable_lts_backfill: On startup, import the full inception-to-today daily portfolio value series into the Portfolio value sensor's statistics. Requires the value-data endpoint to be available for your API access.
data_description.auto_remove_stale_devices: When a holding is sold, a market exited or a cash account closed, delete its device and entities automatically once it has been gone from your portfolio for three consecutive updates. This also deletes those entities' recorded history. Leave this off to delete them yourself from the device page's three-dot menu.
data_description.enable_extended_performance: Fetch five extra performance windows on the slow poll tier and expose thirty entities on one Extended Performance device. Adds five requests per hour.
data_description.enable_holding_entities: Turn on to create the full per-holding entity family (about 31 entities per holding). New entries keep this off to avoid excessive recorder growth. Existing installations retain their previous setting, and entities are hidden rather than deleted when the option is off.

get_portfolio_summary.name: Get portfolio summary
get_portfolio_summary.description: Return a headline summary for a Sharesight portfolio (value, period gains, top/worst movers, cash and trailing dividend income). Reads only data already held by the integration, so it makes no extra API request.

Makes a few on-demand API requests each time it is called (some are mobile-scoped and may be unavailable to standard API tokens).
